'''Elite Wing 27''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Fighter wing/Legends|fighter wing]] in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]] that fielded elite [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|Droid tri-fighters]] that were often used to supplement other [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]].
